description:
Static, hypnotic low drone (4:58): a deep hum centered around 65 Hz (near a low C) with harmonics at about 129 and 194 Hz, slowly breathing with a strong, regular pulsation about every 4.6 seconds, like a giant machine turning or a slow heartbeat.

The sound stays constant from start to finish, with no high frequencies above about 500 Hz: warm, dark and enveloping. Ideal as a continuous background layer.

Created with the Roland P-6 granular sampler, using its granular engine to generate sustained low tones, further processed with additional effects.

Best heard on headphones or good speakers (strong low-frequency content).

Useful for: spaceship interiors, engine rooms, reactors, sci-fi backgrounds, meditation and drone music, tension underscoring, games.

Technical: WAV, 44.1 kHz / 24-bit, stereo.

Note: very wide stereo image; the low end is partly out of phase and loses energy when summed to mono.
name: Deep Pulsing Space Drone - Static Low Hum (Roland P-6)
